name: goanime-gui
_comment_frontend: The frontend is hand-written ES modules served straight out of frontend/dist and embedded by main.go with //go:embed. There is no bundler and no package.json in that directory, so the install/build hooks are deliberately empty — the previous values ('npm install' / 'npm run build') pointed at a package.json that does not exist and would fail any 'wails build'. Lint and format tooling lives in the repository root package.json instead; see npm run check.
